title: Audit log
purpose: Find who did what, to which resource, when and from where, and export it.
useWhen: A workspace keeps a log of changes that people filter, inspect and export, or a record shows its own activity.
avoidWhen: Notifications meant for someone to act on; use NotificationCenter.
alternatives: Use the async-collection contract for other filtered lists, and NotificationCenter for things that need attention.
requiredInputs: events with actor, action, resource, exact time, origin, before and after
a server query that filters and pages
an export job adapter with progress and a download
transitions: ready → page-loading → ready on a page turn, keeping the rows
ready → ready or no-results on a filter change, back to the first page
ready → expanded on an entry's disclosure
ready → exporting → exported with a download, or export-failed
applicability: Workspace audit logs and record activity feeds.
exceptions: Require only states supported by the application; a log without export skips those states.
